    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Agent
    Anything that can publish messages to topics and/or subscribe to them
    AggregatorAgent
    Base class for agents that combine N input topics into a single output value (PlusAgent, MulAgent, AvgAgent, ...).
    AvgAgent
    Publishes the average of all input topics on pubs[0].
    BaseServlet
    Shared HTTP response helpers to generate common HTTPResponse DTOs.
    BinOpAgent
    Generic two-input agent that applies a BinaryOperator on the two inputs and publishes the result.
    ClearServlet
    POST /clear : removes every topic and agent from the system by clearing the TopicManagerSingleton, then returns an empty graph so the front-end resets its view.
    Config
    Builds the agents that make up the computational graph.
    Config
    Jackson DTO for a whole uploaded configuration: a wrapper around the list of AgentConfig entries found under the JSON "agents" field.
    ConfLoader
    POST /upload : accepts a JSON configuration in the "config" form field, strictly validates it against ConfigDTO, rebuilds the agent graph, and returns the new graph as JSON.
    ContentType
    Maps common file extensions to their HTTP Content-Type (MIME) values, used by the static resource servlet to label responses.
    DivAgent
    Publishes subs[0] / subs[1] on pubs[0].
    GenericConfig
    Reflection-based implementation of Config that builds the computational graph from a JSON configuration file.
    Graph
    The full set of nodes representing the current pub-sub state.
    GraphDisplayer
    GET /graph : returns the current graph (topics + agents + edges + latest values) as JSON for the front-end to render.
    HTTPException
    Runtime exception carrying an HTTPStatus so servlets can signal an HTTP error (e.g.
    HTTPRequest
    Immutable Data Transfer Object representing an incoming HTTP request.
    HTTPResponse
    Immutable Data Transfer Object representing an outgoing HTTP response.
    HTTPServer
    Public API of the HTTP server.
    HTTPStatus
    The subset of HTTP status codes used by this server, each pairing a numeric code with its standard reason phrase.
    IncAgent
    Publishes subs[0] + 1 on pubs[0] every time it receives a message.
    JsonGraphWriter
    Serializes a Graph to the JSON format expected by Vis.js:
    Main
    Entry point: starts the HTTP server with all endpoints registered, then blocks until the user presses Enter to shut it down.
    Message
    A message exchanged between topics and agents.
    MulAgent
    Publishes the product of all input topics on pubs[0].
    MyHTTPServer
    Minimal multithreaded HTTP server built on top of plain Sockets.
    Node
    One element in the graph view.
    ParallelAgent
    Wraps an agent so its callback runs on its own thread.
    PlusAgent
    Publishes the sum of all input topics on pubs[0].
    RequestParser
    Minimal HTTP request parser.
    ResetServlet
    POST /reset : calls reset() on every agent then publishes "0" on every topic, so the whole system goes back to a clean zeroed state.
    Servlet
    Handles one HTTP endpoint.
    StaticResourceServlet
    GET /app/...
    Topic
    One channel of the pub-sub system: agents subscribe to receive its messages, others register as publishers.
    TopicDisplayer
    GET /publish?topic=...&message=...
    TopicManagerSingleton
    Singleton holder for every Topic in the system.
    TopicManagerSingleton.TopicManager
    The thread-safe registry of every Topic, backed by a ConcurrentHashMap.
